summary: All 16 pieces match their cliff heights in the real-renderer probes (1-4 rows), crest meets upper ground and toe meets the foot track/road, no seams or row mismatches against native beodeul cliff faces or grass lips, palettes sit in the beodeul brown/stone range, and at 1x every cut reads clearly as a way up (ramps as sloped notches, stairs as banded flights). Stacked flights join at the landing strip. No major defects found; minors: ramp surface tone step vs track at crest/toe, smooth wedge walls lacking native rock clusters, thin tread tops on stairs, thin left wall on ramp-h4, notch-like ramp-h1.
